searchText: Example: * call has: 2M regular gas, 2M reservoir * It calls a subcall with (1M regular gas, and 2M reservoir). * Subcalls spends 2.3M state gas, and 0.1M regular gas (This means all 2M of reservoir and 0.4M of regular gas) * This means 0.4M of regular gas contains 0.3M state gas + 0.1M cpu gas * Revert/halt happen. * Question what value for parent call should reservoir be refilled with. Expectation on revert case (state reservoir refilled) do we expect : * parent call to have 1.6M regular gas, and 2M of reservoir. 0.3 of state gas was deducted but it is not spent * parent call to have 1.6M regualr gas, and 2.3M of reservoir. 0.3 og state gas gets added to reservoir Expectation on halt case (state reservoir refilled) do we expect: * parent call to have 1M regular gas, and 2M of reservoir. 0.3 of state gas was deducted but it is not spent * parent call to have 1M regualr gas, and 2.3M of reservoir. 0.3 og state gas gets added to reservoir Idea is to preserve state gas, but dont effect the common regular gas behavior on halt/revert. In we take first expectation, we are having a fake spending of state gas. cc <@755913785620824175>

Example:
* call has: 2M regular gas, 2M reservoir
* It calls a subcall with (1M regular gas, and 2M reservoir).
* Subcalls spends 2.3M state gas, and 0.1M regular gas (This means all 2M of reservoir and 0.4M of regular gas)
    * This means 0.4M of regular gas contains 0.3M state gas + 0.1M cpu gas 
* Revert/halt happen.
* Question what value for parent call should reservoir be refilled with.

Expectation on revert case (state reservoir refilled) do we expect :
* parent call to have 1.6M regular gas, and 2M of reservoir. 0.3 of state gas was deducted but it is not spent
* parent call to have 1.6M regualr gas, and 2.3M of reservoir. 0.3 og state gas gets added to reservoir

Expectation on halt case (state reservoir refilled) do we expect:
* parent call to have 1M regular gas, and 2M of reservoir. 0.3 of state gas was deducted but it is not spent
* parent call to have 1M regualr gas, and 2.3M of reservoir. 0.3 og state gas gets added to reservoir

excerpts.content: Idea is to preserve state gas, but dont effect the common regular gas behavior on halt/revert.  In we take first expectation, we are having a fake spending of state gas.
